result.comments:
10-15-2013 Order PSC-13-0484-FOF-WS 10-15-13 grants certificates 568-S and 664-W to provide water and wastewater service in Hendry and Collier counties effective 9-25-13 as stated in order.  Note: as stated on page one, 1st paragraph of order, Neither Hendry nor Collier county has turned over jurisdiction of the privately owned water and wastewater utilities within its respective county to this Commission, pursuant to Chapter 367.171, F.S. However, pursuant to Section 367.17(7), F.S., we have exclusive jurisdiction over all utility systems whose service transverses county boundaries, whether the counties involved are jurisdictional or nonjurisdictional; therefore, we have jurisdiction over the proposed service area in Hendry and Collier counties. 

10-18-2013 FEID number, Type of Class and Corporate Type from ENG/Melinda Watts.

4/25/2024 - Request from John Wharton to change Liaison 1 from Mitch Hutchcraft to Philip Mullett; and to update title, phone, email address, and mailing address.  -dm
